subject: finance
intro: Finance leads to paid work deciding where money goes — valuing companies and securities, advising households on plans, policing banks, and selling and structuring investments for clients.

roles.title: Financial and Investment Analysts
roles.what: Conduct quantitative analyses of investment programmes and the financial data of public and private institutions — valuing businesses, rating securities and recommending buy, sell or hold decisions.
roles.where: The Equity Investments and Fixed Income units are the analyst's core material — security markets, indexes and valuation models, yield measures — while Financial Statement Analysis provides the reports analysts interrogate before valuing anything.

roles.title: Personal Financial Advisors
roles.what: Advise clients on financial plans using knowledge of tax and investment strategies, securities, insurance, pension plans and real estate — assessing assets, liabilities, cash flow and goals to build a plan they can live by.
roles.where: The Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct unit sets the client-first duty advisors are bound by; Portfolio Management and Equity Investments supply the investment products advisors assemble into household plans.

roles.title: Financial Examiners
roles.what: Review the balance sheets and loan files of banks and insurance companies to confirm they hold enough capital, price risk correctly and comply with the laws that keep the financial system safe.
roles.where: Financial Statement Analysis — reporting procedures and accounting methods — teaches the exact documents examiners scrutinise; the Ethical and Professional Standards unit instils the independence the role demands.

roles.title: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents
roles.what: Buy and sell securities or commodities in investment and trading firms, or provide financial services to businesses and individuals — advising customers on stocks, bonds, mutual funds and other products.
roles.where: Security markets and indexes from the Equity Investments unit explain what these agents trade; Fixed Income securities and Derivatives units teach the products they quote prices on all day.
